name: Arena timekeeper
design: Short stout elderly female with light grey mottled skin, rounded exposed mandible face, white dreadlocks in compact shoulder bundle. Ochre work dress with dark long apron and small bronze shoulder clasps, wide soft black belt. Holds a compact enclosed mechanical timing instrument with concentric rings in both hands at belly, small reset pointer attached to belt. Practical clothes, no numerals or readable text.
